description: Phonetic-fold tables for the romanization-robust key both engines compute (screen.py phonetic_key / scripts/sanctions-match.mjs phoneticKey). Single source of truth: these were duplicated in code, and a duplicated table in this repo has drifted twice already (transliteration groups, then corporate stopwords - the latter costing three hard-negative false positives). Verified before extraction that dropping one digraph from the JS copy broke NO test, so the drift would have been silent.
digraphOrderMatters: digraphs are applied IN ORDER and each is a plain substring replacement, so longer forms must precede their own prefixes: shch before sch before sh, and tch before ch. Reordering silently changes every key.
